descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Vânzări cu amănuntul
We are seeking an experienced and business-oriented Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Team. In this role, you will act as a key partner to business stakeholders, translating strategic priorities and operational needs into high-impact reporting and analytics solutions. You will lead end-to-end dashboard development, data modeling, and performance reporting to empower data-driven decisions across the organization. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Stakeholder Collaboration & Requirement Gathering: Work closely with business teams to understand their goals, capture reporting requirements, and translate business challenges into clear analytical specifications. 
 BI Development & Modeling: Design, build, and maintain production-grade Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and DAX calculations that deliver clear, actionable insights. 
 Data Quality & Governance: Ensure data integrity across reporting pipelines, validate metrics against source databases, and maintain documentation for key KPIs and models. 
 Technical Requirements 
 Mandatory Skills 
 Power BI: Strong hands-on experience in developing end-to-end dashboards, data modeling (star schemas), DAX formulas, and Power BI Service deployment/management. 
 SQL: Strong proficiency in writing complex queries, joins, aggregations, and subqueries to extract and analyze data from relational databases. 
 Nice to Have 
 Google BigQuery: Experience querying large cloud datasets and working with cloud data warehouses. 
 Power Query (M): Experience building automated data transformation and cleaning workflows. 
 Python: Familiarity with Python for data manipulation, automation, or statistical analysis (e.g., pandas, numpy). 
 Experience & Professional Skills 
 4+ years of relevant experience in data analysis and business intelligence. 
 Strong ability to interact with business stakeholders, ask the right questions, and clarify requirements. 
 Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey technical findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
 Strong problem-solving attitude, attention to detail, and focus on delivering business value. 
 What we offer: 
 A team of dedicated professionals committed to making every project a success; 
 A role where your professional development is supported through challenging projects, workshops, training sessions, and managerial guidance; 
 A work environment where your needs, ideas, and ambitions are genuinely valued; 
 A place where your achievements are fairly recognized and rewarded.
